title: Hollow and Crown Again
premise: Lior Oyelaran's ledgers record trades between the human realm of Vess and the Hollow, a neighboring world reached through warded borders — until the wards collapse and the stars above both realms go dark. Hunting the saboteur, Lior discovers he himself is the missing heir to the Hollow's crown, a child smuggled across the border decades ago and erased from every map. The covenant that binds the two worlds is failing because it was sealed with his stolen name. To restore light, Lior must choose between reclaiming a throne built on his erasure or forging a new covenant with the found family of guild misfits who raised him — and in the end he dissolves the crown entirely, sealing the pact with all their names together.
about_author: Theo Vane is the pen name of a former archivist who spent years cataloging maps of places that no longer exist. They write fantasy about people who find belonging in the margins of official records.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Lior Oyelaran balances the Guild of Unmapped Realms' accounts: bottled echoes, borrowed shadows, a debt owed in years. POV Lior. When a client pays with a coin stamped with Lior's own face — aged forty years — the ledger refuses to record it. Emotional beat: quiet unease beneath routine, the first crack in a life Lior believed was fully mapped.

chapters.title: Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: The border wards shatter at moonrise; every star over Vess and the Hollow goes dark at once. POV alternating Lior and Sefa, the guild's ward-smith. Refugees and impossible creatures pour through the broken border while the guild hall becomes an improvised shelter. Emotional beat: chaos forging instant kinship among strangers as the guild family pulls together.

chapters.title: What the Wards Remember
chapters.summary: Sefa reconstructs the ward-collapse from residual sigils and finds they weren't broken — they were unlocked, with a key cut from royal blood. POV Sefa. The trail leads to a name redacted from every guild record: a crown prince of the Hollow, smuggled out as an infant. Emotional beat: dread and protectiveness as Sefa realizes the answer may be someone she loves.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Blind Spot
chapters.summary: Lior maps the Hollow for the first time without wards, discovering blank spaces on his own charts where his childhood memories should be. POV Lior. A Hollow envoy, Lady Irun, arrives claiming kinship and calls him by a name he's never heard: Lioran, Crown-Undrawn. Emotional beat: vertigo of identity, the self as unmapped territory.

chapters.title: Guild of Misfits
chapters.summary: The guild votes on whether to hand Lior to the Hollow's claimants. POV ensemble through guildmaster Odell's eyes. Cook, thief, smith, scribe — each testifies to who Lior is to them, not what he is. The vote: no one surrenders family. Emotional beat: found family made explicit and defiant, warmth against encroaching cold.

chapters.title: The Road Through the Hollow
chapters.summary: Lior, Sefa, and the thief Bram cross into the starless Hollow, guided by Lior's impossible new sight. POV Bram. They witness villages dimming, children born without shadows, a realm literally fading without its covenant-king. Emotional beat: guilt transforming into resolve — Lior sees the cost of his erasure written on strangers' faces.

chapters.title: Court of Ash and Antlers
chapters.summary: At the Hollow's dying court, Lior confronts Lady Irun's truth: she hid him not to save him but to weaponize him later, and the regent who 'unlocked' the wards wants the crown for herself. POV Lior. Betrayal stacks on betrayal; Bram is captured covering their escape. Emotional beat: the lowest point — blood inheritance revealed as theft upon theft.

chapters.title: A Name Is a Debt
chapters.summary: Imprisoned, Lior learns the original covenant was sealed with his true name, freely given by his mother — which is why its theft unmade the stars. POV Sefa, infiltrating the citadel. She reaches Lior through the walls with a guild signal, reminding him names can be given again, differently. Emotional beat: hope rekindled; identity reframed as choice, not birthright.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Climax. At the shattered border, Lior faces the regent as she attempts to seal the covenant with her own blood and claim both crowns. POV Lior. Instead of taking the throne, he offers the covenant a new seal: the names of everyone the guild sheltered, human and Hollow alike, spoken together. The stars reignite one constellation at a time. Emotional beat: sacrifice inverted — power shared instead of seized.

chapters.title: Hollow and Crown Again
chapters.summary: Resolution. The crown dissolved, the Hollow elects its first covenant-council with Lior as cartographer, not king. POV Lior, closing the guild ledger. He writes the final entry: not a trade, but a gift. Back home, the family argues over dinner about who gets the window seat. Emotional beat: belonging chosen and ordinary at last — the map finally matches the territory.
